$comment: The source of the farm stack's image list: every image a farm box runs, the registry reference it is published under, and the environment it needs. .github/workflows/publish.yml renders it into farm-stack-images.json on every release, filling each digest; scripts/farm-stack-images.py does the rendering and fails when this file and docker-compose.yml disagree. docs/farm-stack-images.md describes both. POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: That owner's password. The bench's chirpstack/chirpstack.toml writes the literal `chirpstack` into its DSN; anything real supplies a generated one to both.

images.name: mosquitto
images.description: MQTT broker: ChirpStack, the gateway bridges and the telemetry bridge meet here

POSTGRESQL_HOST.description: Interpolated by the stack's chirpstack/chirpstack.toml, not read by the image itself; the same holds for every variable here.

MQTT_BROKER_HOST.description: Broker host, for the MQTT integration and the region's gateway backend.

API_SECRET.description: Signs ChirpStack's API tokens. The bench ships a placeholder; rotate it for anything reachable.

REGION.description: The enabled region: us915_0 or us915_1. Must equal the gateway bridges' topic prefix.

images.name: chirpstack-rest-api
images.description: ChirpStack's REST gateway: the provisioner's codec attach, the bridge's reconciler and the box's agent go through it

images.name: chirpstack-gateway-bridge
images.description: Gateway bridge, run twice: Semtech UDP (1700/udp) and BasicStation (3001/tcp)

INTEGRATION__MQTT__EVENT_TOPIC_TEMPLATE.description: The first path segment is the region and must equal ChirpStack's REGION.

images.name: provisioner
images.description: One-shot: rotates ChirpStack's seeded admin password to the configured one, ensures the tenant and its API key, and writes them to SHARED_DIR

CHIRPSTACK_GRPC.description: ChirpStack's gRPC API: login, tenant and API key.

CHIRPSTACK_REST_URL.description: REST gateway, for the optional codec attach.

CHIRPSTACK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The admin's password. When it differs from CHIRPSTACK_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD, the seeded one is rotated to it on the first run. Its default, admin, is a placeholder: left unset, ChirpStack keeps a global admin anyone who reaches it can log in as.

CHIRPSTACK_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: The password ChirpStack seeds its admin with; default admin.

TENANT_NAME.description: The tenant to ensure; default Intelligent Farming.

API_KEY_NAME.description: The tenant API key's name; default intelligent-farming-stack.

LEFTENANT_CHIRPSTACK_URL.description: Browser-facing REST URL written into config.json for Leftenant; default http://localhost:8090.

LEFTENANT_MQTT_URL.description: Browser-facing MQTT-over-WebSocket URL written into config.json; default ws://localhost:9001.

LEFTENANT_GATEWAY_BRIDGE_HOST.description: Host a physical gateway forwards to, written into config.json; defaults to LEFTENANT_CHIRPSTACK_URL's host.

SHARED_DIR.description: Where the outputs go; default /shared. config.json there carries apiKey and tenantId, which the telemetry bridge needs.

CODECS_DIR.description: Codec .js files to attach, if any; default /codecs. Absent or empty is a no-op.

LOGIN_RETRIES.description: Login attempts while ChirpStack comes up, two seconds apart; default 60.

images.name: farm-postgres
images.description: PostgreSQL 18 with pg_partman and PostGIS: the farmdata store

POSTGRES_USER.description: The owning superuser: CREATE EXTENSION pg_partman needs one. Services connect as the logins farmdata-migrate mints, never as this.

POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS.description: Read once, at first boot. The builtin locale provider ties collation to the server version rather than the image's libc.

images.name: farmdata-migrate
images.description: One-shot: the farmdata migration chain, the login users, the projection seed

FARM_POSTGRES_HOST_BIND.description: The database host, as the client sees it.

FARM_POSTGRES_HOST_PORT.description: The database port, as the client sees it.

FARM_POSTGRES_USER.description: The owner: the chain creates extensions.

FARM_BRIDGE_LOGIN_USER.description: The login minted for the bridge (member of bridge_writer).

FARM_API_LOGIN_USER.description: The login minted for farmdata-api (member of farm_read).

FARM_BRIDGE_MAINT_LOGIN_USER.description: The login minted for partition maintenance (member of partman_maintainer).

FARM_PROJECTION_SEED.description: A path inside the container: the organization and property projection seed, mounted there.

images.name: telemetry-bridge
images.description: The telemetry bridge daemon: MQTT consumer, inventory reconciler, curation API

FARM_BRIDGE_MQTT_URL.description: The broker. The daemon's own default is a development address.

FARM_BRIDGE_CLIENT_ID.description: Its persistent MQTT session's client id. One daemon per broker.

FARM_POSTGRES_HOST_BIND.description: The database host, as the client sees it.

FARM_POSTGRES_HOST_PORT.description: The database port, as the client sees it.

FARM_POSTGRES_USER.description: The minted bridge login, never the owner.

FARM_BRIDGE_PROPERTY_ID.description: The property an unplaced device lands on. No default. The bench's farm/bridge-entrypoint.sh derives it at start.

FARM_BRIDGE_CHIRPSTACK_URL.description: The REST gateway, for the inventory reconciler. URL, key and tenant are all set or all unset.

FARM_BRIDGE_CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY.description: The tenant API key the provisioner minted. The bench's farm/bridge-entrypoint.sh reads it at start.

FARM_BRIDGE_CHIRPSTACK_TENANT_ID.description: The tenant the provisioner ensured. Read at start like the key.

FARM_BRIDGE_CHIRPSTACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Per-request bound on the REST gateway.

FARM_BRIDGE_CURATION_API.description: The farm-local curation API. Off in the daemon's own default; the stack turns it on. It writes and has no authentication: publish its port on loopback only.

FARM_BRIDGE_CURATION_BIND.description: Inside the container; the published port decides who reaches it.

FARM_BRIDGE_CURATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECO.description: How often the lag is checked.

FARM_BRIDGE_REPORT_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: How often the ingest counters are logged.

FARM_BRIDGE_MAINT_LOGIN_USER.description: The minted maintenance login. Left unset the daemon runs with partition maintenance unscheduled, which the stack treats as a fault.

PGHOST.description: The database host. PGHOST, PGUSER and PGDATABASE are required unless DATABASE_URL is set.

API_GRAPHIQL.description: true serves GraphiQL. The bench turns it on; anything reachable leaves it off.
